description: This header defines functions for viewing tensors as real or complex types, including conversions between complex and real representations, with specific focus on tensor strides, sizes, and storage offsets.

methods.name: view_tensor
methods.description: Creates a new tensor view with specified dtype, offset, sizes, and strides.

methods.name: computeStrideForViewAsReal
methods.description: Computes strides for viewing a complex tensor as real.

methods.name: _view_as_real_physical
methods.description: Converts a complex tensor to its real representation with last dimension of size 2.

methods.name: view_as_real
methods.description: Public API to view a complex tensor as real, handling conjugation checks.

methods.name: computeStrideForViewAsComplex
methods.description: Computes strides for viewing a real tensor as complex.

methods.name: view_as_complex
methods.description: Converts a real tensor with last dimension 2 into a complex tensor.
